title: Adhesive Bonding Machine Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend bonding machines that use adhesives to join items for further processing or to form a completed product. Processes include joining veneer sheets into plywood; gluing paper; or joining rubber and rubberized fabric parts, plastic, simulated leather, or other materials.

tasks.text: Align and position materials being joined to ensure accurate application of adhesive or heat sealing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Adjust machine components according to specifications such as widths, lengths, and thickness of materials and amounts of glue, cement, or adhesive required.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Monitor machine operations to detect malfunctions and report or resolve problems.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Start machines, and turn valves or move controls to feed, admit, apply, or transfer materials and adhesives, and to adjust temperature, pressure, and time settings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Fill machines with glue, cement, or adhesives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of materials into equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Perform test production runs and make adjustments as necessary to ensure that completed products meet standards and specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Conduct test runs of production equipment.

tasks.text: Examine and measure completed materials or products to verify conformance to specifications, using measuring devices such as tape measures, gauges, or calipers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Read work orders and communicate with coworkers to determine machine and equipment settings and adjustments and supply and product specifications.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Remove and stack completed materials or products, and restock materials to be joined.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Stack finished items for further processing or shipment.
Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Observe gauges, meters, and control panels to obtain information about equipment temperatures and pressures, or the speed of feeders or conveyors.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.

tasks.text: Maintain production records such as quantities, dimensions, and thicknesses of materials processed.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Remove jammed materials from machines and readjust components as necessary to resume normal operations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically clearing jams in machinery

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.

tasks.text: Mount or load material such as paper, plastic, wood, or rubber in feeding mechanisms of cementing or gluing machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Transport materials, supplies, and finished products between storage and work areas, using forklifts.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving forklifts requires real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
Operate forklifts or other loaders.

tasks.text: Clean and maintain gluing and cementing machines, using solutions, lubricants, brushes, and scrapers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Measure and mix ingredients to prepare glue.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.
